- What is the difference between PM2.5 and AQI? PM2.5 is a raw concentration measurement (µg/m³). AQI (Air Quality Index) is a standardized index (0–500) calculated from PM2.5 and other pollutants using fixed breakpoints. The two are not numerically interchangeable; AQI must be derived from PM2.5 using the correct formula, not compared directly. [DOC-04]
